decision: Approve the active-section-id convention for the host-designated current section.

evidence.interpretation: The owner approved the naming convention in gate 4 of the SectionNav v0.1 plan. The whole-file plan SHA-256 is 16c42595c77871d8aa04ade026588167604b31c555e38aa2fc3cbdab379aad3f; the exact entry text is in section 4. Not native review authority.

convention.name: activeId
convention.meaning: The host-designated identity of the current section in an ordered section navigation.
convention.whenToUse: Identify the current section by its consumer-supplied stable item id.
convention.avoid: Do not use for a data-table active row, progress value, inferred scroll position or generic selection.
